title: Urenokori no Dorei Elf wo Hirotta node, Musume ni Suru Koto ni Shita
titleRomaji: Urenokori no Dorei Elf wo Hirotta node, Musume ni Suru Koto ni Shita
titleNative: 売れ残りの奴隷エルフを拾ったので、娘にすることにした
synonyms: My daughter was an unsold slave elf.
synopsis: Weiss, witnesses an elf girl being sold into slavery. When he realizes that the girl is not just any elf, but a rare High Elf, he decides to buy her and raise her like a daughter. Weiss finds himself raising a child for the first time. Thanks to his efforts, the girl, who was abused and unable to speak, regains her health. He decides to name her "Lily," after the first word she spoke. Weiss, suddenly a parental figure, now has a new goal, to get Lily into the magic academy! (Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

titleRomaji: Kanojo ni Shitai Joshi Ichii, no Tonari de Mitsuketa Amari-chan
titleNative: 彼女にしたい女子一位、の隣で見つけたあまりちゃん
synonyms: I Found Amari-chan Next to the Number One Girl I Wanted to Make My Girlfriend
synopsis: Fukusuke, a nice but plain guy, falls in love at first sight with the most beautiful girl in class, Yua. However, the one rumored to be with Yua is Fukusuke's best friend, the basketball ace, Yuusei. He is resigned to unrequited love as a background mob character, until he meets another super cute girl, Usuba Amari, who doesn't stand out because she is overshadowed by Yua. “Um, w-would you be my friend?” Fukusuke and Amari, caught in a similar situation, decide to start practicing "how to act normal" together. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
